Key Concepts and Use Cases

Depending on the context, "operative captioning"

can refer to:

e Operative Semiotics (Arts & Theory): A framework proposed in visual media where the caption doesn't just describe a picture; it directs how the viewer perceives and interprets the image's meaning. 2
